notablePrerequisites:
Speaker of the Heavens does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least seven greater than your starting life total.
It is your turn.
description:
Activate Speaker of the Heavens by tapping it, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying.
The Angel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
